gates.name: PRODUCT TRUTH
gates.x: The tool identifies reproducible public website findings.
gates.y: Fixture tests plus at least one live pilot finding reproduced independently by a human.
evidenceRequired: Deterministic CI green on fixture-backed tests.
A live audit of a target the operator is authorised to audit.
A second person follows the 'How to reproduce' steps and observes the same result.
currentEvidence: 59 deterministic core tests + 8 worker tests, all fixture-backed (see README).
No live pilot has been executed yet. Gate stays OPEN until one is documented.

gates.name: USER VALUE
gates.x: A business owner understands what needs attention faster than with the raw technical output.
gates.y: Measured baseline-vs-Argus task study (time-to-understanding, comprehension questions).
evidenceRequired: A small task study with real non-technical participants.
Baseline = raw tool output (for example curl output) vs Argus reports.
currentEvidence: Three report renderers implemented (SIMPLE / ENGINEER / CLIENT) with progressive disclosure.
No study has been run. Gate stays OPEN.

gates.name: COMMERCIAL SIGNAL
gates.x: Businesses request or pay for deeper analysis/remediation.
gates.y: Real pilot/conversion data only. No invented demand.
evidenceRequired: At least one documented request or payment for a deeper audit.
Conversion data recorded from real interactions only.
currentEvidence: No billing, no accounts, no contact flow implemented in V0.
Gate begins BLOCKED. Do not unblock without real pilot data.
gates.blockedUntil: Real pilot interactions exist and are recorded.
